role_place: Byzantine emperor 1391-1425; wrote the Dialogue with a Persian (Mudarris) during his stay at Ankara in the Ottoman court, winter 1391-92.
why_relevant: His Dialogue with a Persian is the best-known Byzantine Greek debate with a Muslim scholar on Muhammad, the Qur'an and the Christian faith.
fame: Very well known in the scholarly literature since Hase's 1810 edition of Dialogues I-II; the Seventh Dialogue became world-famous through the Regensburg lecture (Benedict XVI, 2006), which quoted it in a German rendering.
orthodox_status: emperor (Eastern Orthodox; Byzantine basileus; not a saint)
